syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.ja: ムホスで Googleが / [まず] 330ヘクタールを / 伐採。

captions.source: About 330 ha cleared at Muhos: Google's own figure (Fortune 26 Oct 2026; Kainuun Sanomat; Maaseudun Tulevaisuus). The site company is Tuike Finland, which represents Google; Google has confirmed the site and the figure, so the caption names Google (owner, 3 Nov: 'use Google for the Finland data centers for now'). 'First' is the station's word for the order of events: the clearing came before the water plan the regulator later demanded (caption 5).

text.ja: そして 当局が / [停止を] 命じた。

captions.source: LVV (Lupa- ja valvontavirasto, the licensing and supervisory authority) asked Tuike Finland on 6 Oct 2026 to stop the work, with compliance due 23 Oct (Kaleva; Satakunnan Kansa). The lvv.fi release title was seen; the page is blocked from here.

text.ja: 今は 警察が / [調べて] いる。

captions.source: The Oulu Police Department decided to investigate Tuike Finland over the preparatory work at Muhos, on suspected breaches of environmental law (Reuters 29 Oct 2026, via Al Jazeera, Courthouse News, The Star). Yle reports five requests for an investigation. The Finnish term differs between summaries (esitutkinta / esiselvitys), so the copy uses the plain verb in every language (tutkii; 調べている) and claims no charge.

text.ja: 現場は / [黒色頁岩] 地帯。

captions.source: LVV places the site in the black-shale area and says monitoring already shows changes pointing to acidification (Kaleva; Satakunnan Kansa; Uutissuomalainen). Black shale holds sulphides that turn acid when dug up and exposed to air (GTK, general geology). The ditch in the picture is the reported ditching (its notice was late and it needs a Water Act permit); the ditch walls' layers are drawn, not surveyed.

text.ja: まず 伐って、 / 計画は [後回し]。

captions.source: The station's line. The detailed water-management plan, covering the acid-producing soils and extreme runoff, is due on 5 Nov 2026, after the clearing (Kaleva; Satakunnan Kansa; Uutissuomalainen); a conditional fine is possible. The tag beside it is Google's side: a spokesperson said it will replant 130 ha (Kainuun Sanomat; MT; Fortune, which notes that is less than half of what was cleared).

post.en: In Muhos, Finland, Google cleared ~330 ha of forest for a data centre. The regulator ordered a halt on 6 Oct; Oulu police are investigating. The site is in a black-shale zone. Google says it will replant 130 ha. A detailed water plan was due 5 Nov. Shouldn't the plan come first?
post.fi: Muhoksella Google kaatoi noin 330 hehtaaria metsää datakeskuksen tieltä. Lupa- ja valvontavirasto määräsi työt keskeytettäviksi 6.10., ja Oulun poliisi tutkii asiaa. Alue on mustaliuskealuetta. Google kertoo istuttavansa 130 hehtaaria. Vesisuunnitelma on jätettävä 5.11. Eikö suunnitelman pitäisi tulla ensin?
post.ja: フィンランドのムホスで、Googleはデータセンターのために約330ヘクタールの森を伐採した。当局は10月6日に作業の停止を命じ、オウル警察が調べている。現場は黒色頁岩地帯。Googleは130ヘクタールを植林するとしている。水管理計画の期限は11月5日。計画が先では？
